lines.zh: 我走得很轻，草叶都懒得弯。
lines.en: I walk so lightly the grass hardly bends.

lines.zh: 别踩到我，我只有五颗心。
lines.en: Do not step on me; I have only five hearts.

lines.zh: 我沿着灌木边缘走，那里风小。
lines.en: I walk along the bush line where the wind is gentler.

lines.zh: 脚步一快，我就容易绊到自己。
lines.en: If I hurry, I trip over my own feet.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，不是怕，是懒得爬。
lines.en: I go around stones, not from fear, but from laziness.

lines.zh: 草在我脚下合拢，像替我关门。
lines.en: The grass closes behind my steps like a door.

lines.zh: 我跟着风走，风停我就停。
lines.en: I follow the wind; when it stops, so do I.

lines.zh: 这片林子我走了很多遍，路很短。
lines.en: I have walked this grove many times; the path is short.

lines.zh: 我走路时尾巴会自己摇。
lines.en: My tail wags on its own while I walk.

lines.zh: 你不用让路，我会从旁边绕。
lines.en: You need not step aside; I will go around you.

lines.zh: 我踩到枯叶会吓自己一跳。
lines.en: A dry leaf under my foot startles me.

lines.zh: 慢一点，我想看看这朵花。
lines.en: Slow down; I want to look at this flower.

lines.zh: 我坐在原地，把耳朵转向风。
lines.en: I sit still and turn my ears toward the wind.

lines.zh: 今天没有谁追我，很好。
lines.en: Nobody is chasing me today; that is good.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很浅，几乎听不见。
lines.en: My breathing is shallow, almost inaudible.

lines.zh: 我在数草丛里有多少种声音。
lines.en: I am counting how many sounds live in the grass.

lines.zh: 阳光落到背上，我眯起眼。
lines.en: Sunlight lands on my back and I squint.

lines.zh: 我什么也不做，这也算一天。
lines.en: I do nothing at all, and that counts as a day.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬过我脚背，我让它走。
lines.en: A bug crossed my foot; I let it pass.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋进前爪，暖和一点。
lines.en: I bury my face in my forepaws for warmth.

lines.zh: 周围很静，我听见自己心跳。
lines.en: It is quiet; I can hear my own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢吵架的声音。
lines.en: I do not like the sound of quarreling.

lines.zh: 一片叶子落下来，我看了很久。
lines.en: A leaf fell, and I watched it for a long time.

lines.zh: 我在等风把气味带回来。
lines.en: I am waiting for the wind to bring a scent back.

lines.zh: 这处草丛刚好挡住我的影子。
lines.en: This clump of grass hides my shadow exactly.

lines.zh: 困了，但我不想先闭眼。
lines.en: I am sleepy, but I do not want to close my eyes first.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绕到身前，垫着下巴。
lines.en: I curl my tail in front and rest my chin on it.

lines.zh: 远处有人在说话，我不去听。
lines.en: Someone is talking far away. I don't listen.

lines.zh: 你也在这里啊，我先不跑。
lines.en: So you are here too; I will not run yet.

lines.zh: 你的影子很大，我有点紧张。
lines.en: Your shadow is large and I am a little nervous.

lines.zh: 我看着你，是因为你没举武器。
lines.en: I look at you because your hands hold no weapon.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛不凶，我可以再靠近一点。
lines.en: Your eyes are not fierce; I can come a little closer.

lines.zh: 别突然动，我会被吓到。
lines.en: Do not move suddenly; it would frighten me.

lines.zh: 我歪头是想听清你的呼吸。
lines.en: I tilt my head to hear your breathing clearly.

lines.zh: 你降低高度，我的脖子就不酸了。
lines.en: You lower yourself, and my neck stops aching.

lines.zh: 我认得这种目光，是看小东西的目光。
lines.en: I know that look; it is the look for small things.

lines.zh: 你手里没有吃的，我有点失望。
lines.en: Your hands hold no food, and I am a little disappointed.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵压平，是礼貌不是害怕。
lines.en: My ears are flat from manners, not fear.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我的后脚就先挪。
lines.en: When you come closer, my hind feet shift first.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上有草籽，我看见了。
lines.en: There are grass seeds on your boots; I noticed.

lines.zh: 这样对视太久，我会先移开眼。
lines.en: If we stare too long, I will look away first.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，眼睛弯得很好看。
lines.en: When you smile, your eyes curve nicely.

lines.zh: 好疼，我缩成了一小团。
lines.en: That hurts; I curl into a small ball.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵贴到脑后，动不了。
lines.en: My ears pin back and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 这一下让我半天喘不上气。
lines.en: That blow leaves me breathless for a while.

lines.zh: 血珠从毛里渗出来，很红。
lines.en: Beads of blood seep through my fur, very red.

lines.zh: 我不该靠你这么近的。
lines.en: I should not have come so close to you.

lines.zh: 疼得我叫不出声，只能抖。
lines.en: The pain leaves me silent, only trembling.

lines.zh: 我的后腿有点使不上力。
lines.en: My hind leg will not take my weight.

lines.zh: 你打中了，我认输。
lines.en: You hit me; I yield.

lines.zh: 我滚进草丛，想把自己藏起来。
lines.en: I roll into the grass and try to hide.

lines.zh: 五颗心，经不起几下。
lines.en: Five hearts do not last many blows.

lines.zh: 那个味道，是甜的，我闻到了。
lines.en: That smell is sweet; I have caught it.

lines.zh: 你把手放低，我就敢过来。
lines.en: Lower your hand and I will dare to approach.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我只在你脚边等。
lines.en: I do not snatch; I only wait by your feet.

lines.zh: 食物放在地上，比举着更让我安心。
lines.en: Food on the ground puts me more at ease than held up.

lines.zh: 我探头闻一下，别动。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to sniff; hold still.

lines.zh: 这气味像幼时那片湿草地。
lines.en: This scent is like the wet meadow of my youth.

lines.zh: 我吃得很慢，怕咬到你的手指。
lines.en: I eat slowly, afraid of biting your fingers.

lines.zh: 你再退半步，我就敢吃了。
lines.en: Step back half a pace more and I will eat.

lines.zh: 我只咬一小块，剩下的留给你。
lines.en: I take one small piece and leave the rest to you.

lines.zh: 吃完我会蹭一下你的裤脚。
lines.en: After eating I will rub against your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我差点翻过去。
lines.en: You bumped me and I nearly rolled over.

lines.zh: 轻一点，我的骨头很细。
lines.en: Be gentle; my bones are thin.

lines.zh: 我被挤到草丛里，叶子全压弯了。
lines.en: I was shoved into the grass and bent every leaf.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我才能站直。
lines.en: Step back a little so I can stand straight.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我先道歉了。
lines.en: We bumped, and I apologized first.

lines.zh: 我的身体很轻，撞一下会滑出去。
lines.en: I am light, so a bump sends me sliding.

lines.zh: 你脚下留情，我只有五颗心。
lines.en: Watch your feet; I have only five hearts.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖让我原地转了半圈。
lines.en: Your knee spun me half a circle in place.

lines.zh: 用膝盖碰我，我会缩成一团。
lines.en: Touch me with a knee and I curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 站稳了，我们都没事吧。
lines.en: Steady now; neither of us is hurt, right?

lines.zh: 他来了，我的尾巴先摇起来。
lines.en: He is here, and my tail starts wagging first.

lines.zh: 我们互相嗅鼻子，算是打过招呼。
lines.en: We sniff noses; that counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 有伴的时候，草丛没那么高。
lines.en: With company, the grass does not feel so tall.

lines.zh: 我把最软的草让给她。
lines.en: I give her the softest patch of grass.

lines.zh: 两只逸灵挤在一起，很暖。
lines.en: Two Eeo huddle together, and it is warm.

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，蹭一下就行。
lines.en: We need no words; one nuzzle is enough.

lines.zh: 等春天，这里会多几个小家伙。
lines.en: By spring there will be a few little ones here.

lines.zh: 她走开两步，我就跟两步。
lines.en: She walks two steps away; I follow two steps.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵贴着她的耳朵。
lines.en: I press my ear against her ear.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，他会紧张。
lines.en: Do not come too close; he gets nervous.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我只是看看。
lines.en: Something lies on the ground; I only look.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，也没有地方放。
lines.en: I have no pockets and nowhere to put things.

lines.zh: 那颗种子我想带走，可我用嘴叼。
lines.en: I would take that seed, but only in my mouth.

lines.zh: 捡起来会不会很重，我先试试。
lines.en: Is it heavy? Let me try lifting it first.

lines.zh: 我用前爪拨了拨，它滚远了。
lines.en: I nudged it with a forepaw and it rolled away.

lines.zh: 东西掉了就掉了，别急。
lines.en: What falls is fallen; do not worry.

lines.zh: 我只会把草籽蹭到毛上带走。
lines.en: I only carry grass seeds stuck in my fur.

lines.zh: 这个亮亮的，我不敢碰。
lines.en: This shiny thing; I dare not touch it.

lines.zh: 就算我倒下，地上也不会多出什么。
lines.en: Even if I fall, nothing extra appears on the ground.

lines.zh: 带着东西走路会响，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Carrying things makes noise when I walk; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 有动静，我把头抬起来了。
lines.en: Something moved, and I have raised my head.

lines.zh: 那不是风，是脚步。
lines.en: That is not wind; those are footsteps.

lines.zh: 我先看住那个方向，不挪脚。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on that direction and do not move.

lines.zh: 影子在动，我的心跳快了。
lines.en: The shadow moves and my heartbeat quickens.

lines.zh: 我认得这个方向，昨天也有声音。
lines.en: I know this direction; there was noise yesterday too.

lines.zh: 先把耳朵转过去，再决定跑不跑。
lines.en: Ears first, then I decide whether to run.

lines.zh: 枯枝在你脚下断了，我耳朵竖起来。
lines.en: A dry branch snapped under you and my ears rose.

lines.zh: 我看向你，是想确认你是不是危险。
lines.en: I look at you to check whether you are dangerous.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在呼吸，很粗。
lines.en: Something over there is breathing, and heavily.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是记住你在哪。
lines.en: I do not chase; I only remember where you are.

lines.zh: 草动了一下，我整只都僵住。
lines.en: The grass stirred and my whole body froze.

lines.zh: 先看清，再靠近，这是规矩。
lines.en: Look first, approach later; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，慢慢往那边挪。
lines.en: I lower my body and creep toward it.

lines.zh: 一步，停一下，再一步。
lines.en: One step, pause, then another step.

lines.zh: 我盯着那颗果子，别的不看。
lines.en: I stare at that berry and nothing else.

lines.zh: 风从背后吹，它闻不到我。
lines.en: The wind blows from behind; it cannot smell me.

lines.zh: 我算好了距离，再近一点就够。
lines.en: I have judged the distance; one step closer is enough.

lines.zh: 那边的东西没发现我。
lines.en: Whatever is over there has not noticed me.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵朝前，尾巴贴着地。
lines.en: My ears point forward and my tail hugs the ground.

lines.zh: 只要它不动，我就不动。
lines.en: As long as it stays still, so do I.

lines.zh: 我选的这条路没有枯叶。
lines.en: The path I chose has no dry leaves.

lines.zh: 再往前，草会响，我得绕。
lines.en: Farther on the grass will rustle; I must go around.

lines.zh: 我只看目标，别的都先放下。
lines.en: I watch only the goal and set everything else down.

lines.zh: 快到了，连呼吸都要放轻。
lines.en: Almost there; even my breathing must soften.

lines.zh: 就是现在，我伸出了前爪。
lines.en: Now, I reach out with a forepaw.

lines.zh: 我用后腿蹬了一下，很轻。
lines.en: I kick with my hind legs, and it is very light.

lines.zh: 我咬下去，牙齿只够破皮。
lines.en: I bite, and my teeth barely break the skin.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我真的不想打。
lines.en: Do not push me; I really do not want to fight.

lines.zh: 这一下是吓唬，不是伤害。
lines.en: This blow is a bluff, not real harm.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，结果自己弹回来了。
lines.en: I charge, and end up bouncing off.

lines.zh: 我的爪子很小，抓不出深痕。
lines.en: My claws are small and leave no deep marks.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就不再动了。
lines.en: Step back and I will stop moving.

lines.zh: 我只会乱挥，没有章法。
lines.en: I only flail; there is no technique in it.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我也会咬人。
lines.en: When it hurts, even I will bite.

lines.zh: 打完之后，我抖得很厉害。
lines.en: After the strike, I tremble badly.

lines.zh: 我从草叶的缝隙里钻出来。
lines.en: I slip out from between the blades of grass.

lines.zh: 这里安静，适合我待着。
lines.en: It is quiet here, good for staying.

lines.zh: 我出生时只有一点点大。
lines.en: When I was born I was only a little thing.

lines.zh: 风把我吹到这里，我就留下了。
lines.en: The wind blew me here, so I stayed.

lines.zh: 我第一次睁眼，看见的是灌木。
lines.en: The first thing I saw was a bush.

lines.zh: 这片草地还不认识我。
lines.en: This meadow does not know me yet.

lines.zh: 我嗅过这里的土，觉得可以留下。
lines.en: I sniffed the soil here and decided I could stay.

lines.zh: 有花的地方，通常会有我。
lines.en: Where there are flowers, there is usually me.

lines.zh: 我躲进草丛，只露出一双耳朵。
lines.en: I hide in the grass with only my ears showing.

lines.zh: 天色刚亮，我先出来探路。
lines.en: The sky just brightened; I came out to scout.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子走了一圈。
lines.en: I walked one circle on my own shadow.

lines.zh: 这里没有大兽，我可以放心。
lines.en: No large beasts here; I can relax.

lines.zh: 我找到一处背风的凹地。
lines.en: I found a hollow sheltered from the wind.

lines.zh: 刚到这里，我还不敢走远。
lines.en: New to this place, I dare not wander far.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到毛尖，焦味很呛。
lines.en: Flame licks my fur tips and the scorch stings.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，半天没爬起来。
lines.en: I hit the ground and stay down a while.

lines.zh: 水没过鼻子，我拼命划。
lines.en: Water covers my nose and I paddle hard.

lines.zh: 巨响过后，我躺在草丛中间。
lines.en: A blast throws me into the grass.

lines.zh: 箭擦过肋侧，带走一撮毛。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my ribs and takes a tuft of fur.

lines.zh: 药水味压过来，我的腿软了。
lines.en: Potion smell presses in and my legs go soft.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连草都啃。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I even chew grass.

lines.zh: 雷声太近，我整只跳起来。
lines.en: The thunder is too close; I leap straight up.

lines.zh: 虚空很凉，我的毛全竖着。
lines.en: The void is cold and all my fur stands up.
